name: WHEN THE OCEAN MEETS THE SKY
source:
In a peculiar world where the entirety of the planet's lower biosphere is covered in water, and its upper layers inhabited by villages in the clouds– an owl who lives in the serene countryside and a manta ray who would prefer to write poetry than serve in their naval fleet meet every sunset, where the ocean meets the sky.

[From [url=https://yurionair.itch.io/when-the-ocean-meets-the-sky-demo]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一个奇特的世界里，地球的整个下层生物圈都被水覆盖，上层则居住着云中的村庄——一只生活在宁静乡村的猫头鹰和一条宁愿写诗而不是在海军舰队中服役的蝠鲼在每个日落时相遇，在那里海洋与天空相遇。

[来自[url=https://yurionair.itch.io/when-the-ocean-meets-the-sky-demo]itch.io[/url]]
